item.title: Only One 2 ~Bijin Casino Dealer Hitomi~Sei no Roulette~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Globe
  • 発売日: 2005-02-18
  • スコア: 6.39/10 (8 人評価)
  • 日本語名: オンリーワン2～美人カジノディーラー瞳～性のルーレット～
  • 英語名: Only One 2 Bijin Casino Dealer HitomiSei no Roulette~

あらすじ

Hitomi is a №1 card dealer and bartender at the “Testament” casino. One day she hits a man on her car. Man has no injuries, but loses memory upon awakening. Since he has no identification, he gets name “Kenta” and starts to live under the same roof. Eventually Kenta gets attracted to Hitomi and receives a job at the same casino. Soon he becomes aware of the hidden emotions of his everyday life in Testament.

  • 日本語名: オンリーワン2 ～召しませ 恵のすぃ～とエプロン～
  • 英語名: Only One 2 Meshimase Megumi no Sweet Apron

あらすじ

Main character finishes chef training in Europe and returns back to his home town. His parents die in a traffic accident leaving him a western-style restaurant “Hidden Rabbit”. He’s good at cooking, but he totally fails as a manager, so he calls a female childhood friend to take this position. Alas, she’s no good as a waitress. They find a cheerful waitress to chase their dreams together.
